selection_requirements.diameter_rule: Match individual catalogue intervals only. Series overview is summary and does not prove continuous coverage.
selection_requirements.depth_rule: Check L1, actual reach/clearance and clamping. Pages155/156/159 explicitly label L1 as boring depth; pages152/153 show a front-neck L1 geometry and require clearance confirmation. The meaning of L varies by drawing and must not be assumed to be usable depth or always overall length.
selection_requirements.clamping_rule: Confirm holder/adaptor compatibility using clamping-data.json before returning a complete assembly.
selection_requirements.insert_rule: Keep exact part numbers separate from catalogue family wildcards. Do not equate CCGH060204, CCGH0602U, CCFT060204, or CCFW060204 by similar spelling.

value_conventions.null: not listed / catalogue dash / no unambiguous per-row mapping; never guessed
value_conventions.catalog: direct catalogue table or diagram values; merged cells inherited only after PNG verification
value_conventions.derived: nominal_D is decoded from catalogue part/type ordering code; coverage unions and gaps computed from listed row intervals
value_conventions.row_array_rule: Each group declares columns. Defaults and source_ref apply to all rows in that group. Dimension units are mm unless stated.
value_conventions.total_L_rule: 99146 catalogue tables have no L column. L_mm_catalog is null; fixed drawing dimensions are preserved separately, without fabricating L.
value_conventions.torque_note: Catalogue asterisk states that a torque screwdriver is recommended.
